# Champion

- Full Name (Company) - @githubhandle

*Every initiative must have a champion, to even be proposed - this is the primary
point person for making sure the inititive stays on track, coordinating

*Champions may be changed, but if an initiative ever loses a champion, it will
immediately be closed.*
